segments.vo: Then I found socks that literally lock together.
Tiny magnet on the cuff keeps the pair together in the wash.

winning_angle.pain: losing one sock of a pair in the wash

winning_angle.why: Everyone has a drawer of single socks, so the first line is instantly relatable; the open washer makes the problem visible before the product appears.
